title: Kotler names 'atmospherics'
description: Philip Kotler's Journal of Retailing paper argues the sensory design of a space is a marketing tool in its own right.

title: Appleton publishes The Experience of Landscape
description: Prospect-refuge theory: people prefer places where they can see out while feeling sheltered.

title: Ulrich's window-view study appears in Science
description: Surgical patients with a view of trees recovered faster than matched patients facing a brick wall.

title: 'Scent-Emitting Systems' patent granted
description: Robert E. McCarthy's US 4,603,030, filed 20 September 1984, describes the programmable multi-scent dispenser known in Disney parks as the Smellitzer.

title: Bitner publishes 'Servicescapes'
description: Journal of Marketing paper linking ambient conditions, layout and signage to customer and employee behaviour.

title: Haunted Mansion Holiday debuts at Disneyland
description: The Nightmare Before Christmas overlay opens, becoming the model for annual seasonal re-dressing of a dark ride.

title: Disneyland refreshes the Main Street, U.S.A. music loop
description: First change in about twenty years; over a dozen period-style arrangements join the existing loop.

title: Pandora – The World of Avatar opens
description: A land designed to transform at night, with bioluminescent plants driven by LEDs, fibre optics and blacklight.
